descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Algebra (Modelling) — Mathematical Modelling for Real-Life Community Situations (C4)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-3 unit on mathematical modelling (C4) framed around 'Math in My Community' — Coach Cara the Community Captain and Sport Sam the Sports Reporter. Children walk through the 5-step modelling cycle for community-scale situations: rinks, libraries, restaurants, parks, transit.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Community Modellers. Day 1 introduces community situations and math questions (C4). Day 2 collects community-scale data. Day 3 predicts using rules and big multiplication. Day 4 reflects and refines models with proportional refinements. Day 5 closes with child-chosen capstone projects modelling situations from their own community life. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson

10 printable teacher manipulatives plus 2 character puppets: community map, data charts (6), modelling cycle chart, community situation cards (12), prediction chart, capstone template, two-colour counters, number line to 1000, coach's modelling chart, community poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Coach Cara and Sport Sam
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 single-row summative rubric covering C4 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 capstone
Junior Community Modeller certificate (one per child)
Detailed expanded walkthroughs covering common misconceptions
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers covering the C4 cluster — mathematical modelling at community scale.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. The community map and modelling cycle chart are anchors — children walk through 5 steps physically. Lesson 1 conceptualises situations and questions. Lesson 2 collects data. Lesson 3 predicts at scale. Lesson 4 reflects with proportional refinement. Lesson 5 capstone integrates everything.
